notes.title: Preserve Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Preservers! 🌿 🍃 

The first batch of bugfixes 🐞 and quality-of-life improvements is here. Based on your feedback, we fixed and implemented following features:

[list]
[*] Added remappable Undo button shortcut,
[*] Added remappable habitat UI toggle shortcut ( TAB ) ,
[*] Fixed the unobtainable score in jurassic puzzle 20,
[*] Fixed camera movement when using windows OSK,
[*] Hadrosaurus model and card match (head crest adjusted),
[*] Fixed savanna rivers on mountains,
[*] Adjusted the background behind the score meter for better score visibility,
[*] Fixed Marine kelp color
[/list]

Thank you for your awesome feedback, we really appreciate it! 🤝 🙇

notes.title: Preserve Patch 0.8.19

Hey Preservers,

notes.title: New update: Leaderboards are here, Preservers!
notes.notes:
It’s time to see how your preservation skills measure up! 

As teased in our previous announcement, [b]Preserve is getting Leaderboards! 
[/b]
Here’s what you can look forward to:
[b]
1. Biomes and Map Sizes[/b]
[i]Leaderboards will be divided by biomes and map sizes, so you can dominate your favorite areas and see how you stack up against others.
[/i]
[b]2. Fair Play Competition[/b]
[i]Prove your preserving prowess and climb the ranks—this is your moment to shine!
[/i]

A few things to note:

1. The current chart features scores from our testers and developers. [b]These are placeholders and will be cleared before the update officially launches.[/b]
2. When Preserve hits its 1.0 launch, [b]all leaderboard scores will be reset to ensure a level playing field[/b]. Don’t worry—[b]your progress and achievements are here to stay![/b]

Ready to claim the preserving throne and secure the top spot?

Stay tuned—more updates are on the horizon! 

Happy preserving (and climbing to the top)!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441441/7440b44e209cca22a386cd994875d5a007c9739c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Preserve Patch 0.6.69
notes.notes:
Hey Preservers!

We've just rolled out a new smaller patch for Preserve. Here’s what’s changed:

[list]
[*] Language Support Update: For this update, we've temporarily reduced supported languages to English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Ukrainian, Slovak, and Czech. We’re committed to bringing back more languages in the future once we can ensure they’re fully up to date with our latest content and changes. Thanks for your understanding!
[*] Mac Build Fix: Resolved an issue preventing the game from running smoothly on macOS.
[*] Achievements Update: Achievements now unlock retroactively for players who have met the requirements.
[/list]

notes.title: Important Update for MacOS Users!
notes.notes:
Hello Preservers,

We’re aware of an issue with the recent update of Preserve on MacOS, where the game is currently not launching as expected. Our team is actively working on a fix and we’re doing everything we can to get this resolved as quickly as possible.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. We’ll keep you updated on our progress!

[i]The Preserve Dev Team[/i]

notes.title: New update is coming! Preserve gets enriched with a Compendium!
notes.notes:
Hey Preservers!

The [b]New Update is here[/b]—find all the additional information on cards, including their scoring, placement rules, gameplay effects, and even some interesting trivia in the newly featured [b]COMPENDIUM.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441441/66282a0a83ace5d64efd94e4de8fddbf4fc0586a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441441/bda7634c234cf3d9d9204403a281dc1196f3a788.png[/img]


Other [b]minor changes[/b] included in this update:

- The removal card action can now be canceled.
- The minimum river length has been adjusted from 3 to 2.
- In Classic Mode, additional information boxes for each map size unlock, providing more clarity on progression.
- Graphics Options: Updated FSR (FidelityFX Super Resolution) to the latest version for enhanced visual performance.

[b]Other Improvements[/b]:

- Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.
- Numerous bug fixes for a more stable experience.


Don’t forget to keep your feedback coming! More updates are on the way!
Enjoy the world of PRESERVE!
Cheers!

notes.title: Preserve Next Fest Demo Patch Notes 06/10/2024
notes.notes:
Hey Preservers! 🌱
We are excited to bring you an updated demo for Steam Next Fest that adds to the original content. Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] An unlocked new biome - Savanna (Small map)
[*] 5 new puzzles in the puzzle mode for the Continental biome
[*] 5 new puzzles in the puzzle mode for the Savanna biome
[*] Creative mode with Savanna assets and increased tile limit to 60
[/list]

In addition to the new features, we also bring a huge number of improvements:

[list]
[*] Added an Undo button, allowing you to revert your last action.
[*] Option to rebind controls
[*] Added Tooltips on cards and buttons
[*] Various UI/UX improvements
[*] Improved tutorial based on your feedbacks
[*] Added new Loading tips
[*] Improved cursor highlighting
[*] Improved animal movement
[*] Multiple minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for trying out our demo! Your feedback is crucial in helping us improve the game. Please share your thoughts on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/kpuW5JaAep]Discord[/url] or Steam page.
